description:
Render a pulsing indicator on tool-call nodes that are in-flight.

=== Scope ===

Per ARCH §12 v0.5 success criterion: "pulsing tool indicators". Per §3.3 tool calls land as commits with a per-call disk record under steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/tools/<tool-id>/ holding input.json and output.json.

- A tool call is in-flight when input.json exists but output.json does not (definition pinned by §3.3).
- View-model: each tool-call node carries a state enum { in_flight, complete }. Derived purely from filesystem inspection — no separate state file.
- Renderer: in-flight nodes pulse (egui's repaint_after / time-based opacity or radius). Complete nodes render statically.
- Animation drives a repaint_after request so the egui app stays alive while pulsing without continuous repaint.

=== Tests ===

- Unit: from_repo on a fixture with input.json + no output.json yields a ToolCall with state=in_flight; with both files present yields state=complete.
- Renderer test: in-flight node calls ctx.request_repaint_after(...); complete node does not.

=== Non-goals ===

- Distinct animations for different tool types.
- Progress indicators based on tool-internal state.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: UI: pulsing indicators for in-flight tool calls
